findings.root_cause_task1_task2: In turn 2 chat output, the assistant hallucinated profile IDs [39, 41, 42, 45, 48] and an incorrect arithmetic formula (8 * 10 = 80 instead of 8 * 11 = 88). In reality, the NetCDF file only contains [34, 37, 38, 44, 55, 64, 78, 82] within the NIO basin, and the code scripts/validate_argo_phase4.py and reports/results/argo_validation_results.json always used [34, 37, 38, 44, 55, 64, 78, 82].
findings.where_107_came_from: 7 (at 5m) + 88 (11 depths from 10m to 500m inclusive with 8 profiles each) + 7 (at 700m) + 5 (at 1000m) = 7 + 88 + 7 + 5 = 107 points.

verdict_answers.D_where_107_came_from: 0 + 7 + 8*11 + 7 + 5 = 107 (11 depths from 10m to 500m have 8 profiles = 88 points)
verdict_answers.E_are_reported_argo_metrics_reproducible: YES (recalculated values match reported metrics to 4 decimal places)
verdict_answers.F_are_metrics_valid_for_contemporaneous_: NO (762-day temporal gap; valid only as cross-temporal stratification test)
verdict_answers.G_is_there_a_profile_selection_bug: NO in code/JSON. YES in the previous assistant chat text which fabricated profile IDs 39, 41, 42, 45, 48.
verdict_answers.H_is_there_a_point_count_bug: NO in code/JSON. The code correctly counts 107 points. The previous chat text had an arithmetic typo claiming 10 depths between 10-500m instead of 11.
verdict_answers.I_can_we_use_current_argo_result_in_fina: YES, PROVIDED it is explicitly labeled as a 'Cross-Temporal Climatological Stratification Transfer Test' and NOT contemporaneous validation.
